facts.fact: Lesotho's Bureau of Statistics says it conducted a workshop on modernizing administrative data for official statistics, financed and supported by the Economic Commission for Africa.

The Lesotho Mounted Police Service has a Serious Crime Statistics report for January to May 2024 against the same months of 2023, shared by the Commissioner of Police with the Lesotho Times, giving 4,960 serious crimes reported and 880 detected.
The Lesotho Mounted Police Service's Serious Crime Statistics report counts crimes the police recorded and cases detected, so it is drawn from police records.
